en.headline: Peking opera series opens Friday at the Cultural Centre
en.dek: The China Peking Opera Art Foundation brings three nights to the Grand Theatre from 11 to 13 September, with a Jockey Club sponsorship.
body: A three-night Peking opera programme titled Xiangjiang Guocuiqing — the 2026 Hong Kong tour of the China Peking Opera Art Foundation — opens on Friday at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Grand Theatre in Tsim Sha Tsui.

Organisers said the run, from 11 to 13 September, is presented with exclusive sponsorship from the Hong Kong Jockey Club to mark National Day and the Mid-Autumn Festival. Performers are drawn from the National Peking Opera Company, the Beijing Peking Opera Theatre and the Tianjin Peking Opera Theatre. Xi-school artist Zhang Jianguo leads the company, joined by Chi Xiaoqiu, Wang Yan, Tian Lei and younger principals.

Friday’s opening is the full play Hongzong Liema (The Red-Maned Steed), scheduled for 7.30pm and linking four classic scenes. Saturday is a youth-cast version of Silang Tanmu (The Fourth Son Visits His Mother). Sunday closes with a highlights concert that organisers said will open with the martial excerpt Zhan Machao. The venue is at 10 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui.

zh.headline: 香江國粹情周五起文化中心連演三晚
zh.dek: 中國京劇藝術基金會香港行9月11日至13日在文化中心大劇院上演，由香港賽馬會獨家贊助，張建國領衔。
body: 「香江國粹情——2026中國京劇藝術基金會香港行」周五起一連三晚在尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院上演。
主辦單位表示，演出由9月11日至13日舉行，由香港賽馬會獨家贊助，向國慶及中秋獻演。陣容來自國家京劇院、北京京劇院及天津京劇院，由奚派名家張建國領衔，遲小秋、王艷、田磊等及中青年演員同台。
周五開幕劇目為全本《紅鬆烈馬》，晚上7時30分演出，串連《武家坡》等折子。周六上演青春版《四郎探母》，周日以京劇名家名段演唱會作結，主辦單位指開場為武戲《戰馬超》。場地為尖沙咀梵士巴利道10號香港文化中心。
